title: Skill overrides
summary: Turns off 7 noisy skills and sets 5 built-in ones to run only when you ask for them.
details: This setting turns off 7 noisy skills and makes 5 built-in ones, like init, simplify and security-review, run only when you ask for them. It keeps automatic skill suggestions from crowding your sessions while leaving every skill available on request. It writes a skillOverrides block into your settings.json; one setting only, no code runs and no network is used.
risk: One setting that switches skills off. No code runs.
